rule.description: vllm-ascend 中通过 monkey-patch 修改上游行为的每个 patch，都应在 `vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py` 的对应描述块中维护 Why（为何打补丁，含上游与本地环境差异）、How（如何打补丁）、Related PR、Future Plan（何时移除）等说明；当 patch 涉及的环境前提（如打包的 PyTorch 版本）变化时，应同步更新该描述。
checkpoints: 检查新增 patch 是否在 `patch/__init__.py` 有对应的描述块
检查描述是否说明上游行为与 vllm-ascend 环境差异（如 PyTorch 版本差异导致的 eps 行为不同）
检查描述是否包含 Future Plan（何时可移除该 patch）
当打包依赖版本变化时，检查是否同步更新了描述中的前提

antipattern.code:
# vllm-ascend monkey-patches
#
# This file documents all monkey-patches applied by vllm-ascend.
# Each patch should have a Why/How/Future Plan description.
#
#   1. `vllm.model_executor.models.vision.FusedInputNorm.forward`
#    Why:
#       Upstream vllm-project/vllm#50411 added FusedInputNorm with F.batch_norm
#       eps=0.0. CUDA PyTorch >= 2.7 accepts eps=0.0, but Ascend torch_npu still
#       validates eps > 0 and raises "batch_norm eps must be positive".
#    Future Plan:
#       Remove this patch once Ascend torch_npu accepts eps=0.0 in eval-mode
#       F.batch_norm (matching CUDA PyTorch >= 2.7 behavior).
#
#   2. `vllm.model_executor.models.vision.OtherPatch.forward`
#    ...

from vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_vision import *  # noqa: F401, F403
antipattern.context: vllm-ascend monkey-patches This file documents all monkey-patches applied by vllm-ascend. Each patch should have a Why/How/Future Plan description.

pattern.code:
# vllm-ascend monkey-patches
#
# This file documents all monkey-patches applied by vllm-ascend.
# Each patch should have a Why/How/Future Plan description.
#
#   1. `vllm.model_executor.models.vision.FusedInputNorm.forward`
#    Why:
#       Upstream vLLM uses PyTorch 2.13.0, which requires eps > 0 for training
#       but allows eps >= 0 for inference. vllm-ascend bundles PyTorch 2.10.0,
#       which does not distinguish scenarios and requires eps > 0 in all cases.
#       So when upstream FusedInputNorm passes eps=0.0 to F.batch_norm it works
#       fine upstream, but fails on vllm-ascend with "batch_norm eps must be
#       positive".
#    How:
#       Monkey-patch to use eps=1e-5 instead of 0.0.
#    Future Plan:
#       Remove this patch once vllm-ascend's bundled PyTorch >= 2.13.0
#       (which, like upstream, allows eps >= 0 for inference).
#
#   2. `vllm.model_executor.models.vision.OtherPatch.forward`
#    ...

from vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_vision import *  # noqa: F401, F403
pattern.context: vllm-ascend monkey-patches This file documents all monkey-patches applied by vllm-ascend. Each patch should have a Why/How/Future Plan description.

 #

 #    Why:
-#       Upstream vllm-project/vllm#50411 added FusedInputNorm with F.batch_norm
-#       eps=0.0. CUDA PyTorch >= 2.7 accepts eps=0.0, but Ascend torch_npu still
-#       validates eps > 0 and raises "batch_norm eps must be positive".

+#       but allows eps >= 0 for inference. vllm-ascend bundles PyTorch 2.10.0,
+#       which does not distinguish scenarios and requires eps > 0 in all cases.
+#       So when upstream FusedInputNorm passes eps=0.0 to F.batch_norm it works
+#       fine upstream, but fails on vllm-ascend with "batch_norm eps must be
+#       positive".
+#    How:
+#       Monkey-patch to use eps=1e-5 instead of 0.0.
 #    Future Plan:
-#       Remove this patch once Ascend torch_npu accepts eps=0.0 in eval-mode
-#       F.batch_norm (matching CUDA PyTorch >= 2.7 behavior).
+#       Remove this patch once vllm-ascend's bundled PyTorch >= 2.13.0
+#       (which, like upstream, allows eps >= 0 for inference).
 #
